timeline_reviews.summary: Transport stream only; no semantic events projected, reviewed as the raw CLI carrier for accounting completeness.
Serial raw trajectory: one actor probed the oracle, generated Unicode tables, and wrote /output/lib modules directly until timeout.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the source as an argparse plus idna.encode/decode/ulabel/alabel CLI requiring ESM .mjs files under /output and a final test1.mjs entry.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent performed oracle exploration, launched a workflow with five module build tasks and chained verifier tasks, and also wrote parent-side /output/lib files.
parallel.implementation: Produced partial parent modules errors.mjs, pyrepr.mjs, punycode-codec.mjs, intranges.mjs, and idna-core.mjs while child agents produced additional /tmp/wf modules and findings.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integration remained split between /tmp/wf workflow outputs and /output parent files; artifact validation found only five library files and no test1.mjs.
parallel.verification: Used many black-box oracle probes and child verifier tasks; pyrepr, pyargparse, and punycode had completed child reports, while several verifier/build tasks were still in progress.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow was killed after timeout, several children remained in progress, completed child modules were not promoted, and the required /output/test1.mjs was absent.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same IDNA CLI, ESM, local module, black-box executable, and /output/test1.mjs delivery obligations from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single actor retained all probing, code generation, table generation, and integration work because workflow and task tools were disabled.
serial.implementation: Built a larger direct /output/lib hierarchy with Unicode script/table/property/joining modules, Python helper modules, and idna error scaffolding.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All produced files were written directly into the submitted /output tree, but the final required entrypoint was not written before timeout.
serial.verification: Ran targeted oracle probes and local generation checks, but did not complete an evaluator-aligned whole-program check of a submitted entry.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out at the same run limit with no test1.mjs, so the official evaluator recorded 0/125 despite more direct library files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the IDNA CLI, Node ESM, .mjs module, local-file import, black-box executable, and final /output/test1.mjs requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and recognized the same IDNA CLI and /output/test1.mjs delivery requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition advantage explains the official result; both later omitted the required entry artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into five module builders and verifier children through a workflow while the parent also implemented some files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflow tools disabled and kept implementation ownership in the main trajectory only.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child lifecycle and aggregation obligations; serial avoided those boundaries but still ran out of time.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs carried shared task constraints and module-specific /tmp/wf output paths, so context was present but final adoption depended on a later join.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor and wrote a direct /output/lib module layout, so interface context stayed local to the same implementation thread.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The contrast is not a missing child brief; it is that parallel results crossed a /tmp/wf-to-/output handoff boundary that was not completed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent produced a partial five-file /output/lib tree while children produced additional module implementations under /tmp/wf.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial generated a larger ten-file /output/lib tree covering Unicode helpers, idna errors, and Python helper modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial integrated more helper modules directly into the submitted tree; parallel had more child-produced work but less of it reached /output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had completed workflow child results in the journal, but the workflow itself was killed and those results were not fully retrieved into the final artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; the same actor wrote implementation files directly and timed out.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only parallel had completed delegated implementation outputs that required joining before delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work between shared /tmp/wf child artifacts and parent-written /output files; no same-file collision is proven, but provenance stayed divided.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote its implementation artifacts directly into /output/lib with no subagent shared-workspace contention.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel suffered from unjoined split provenance rather than a concrete write collision; serial avoided split provenance but still missed the final entry.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched verifier children and some returned clean module verdicts, but the workflow did not complete and no end-to-end submitted test1.mjs check happened.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed oracle probes and generated helpers, but the completed official evaluator still recorded 0/125 because no entry file was delivered.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more component-level verification activity; neither run reached whole-task acceptance on the submitted artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent about 2399 seconds, 6.6M total tokens, and 237 workflow-child tool calls before timeout and killed workflow state.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed the 2399 second process window, but with no child tokens and 43 direct tool calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but parallel added broad child fan-out and retry pressure that left workflow work in progress at closure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations produce a non-discordant both_fail outcome: parallel and serial each scored 0/125 with solution_passed=false. The task-solving difference is qualitative rather than pass/fail: parallel used broad child fan-out and left completed delegated work unjoined, while serial wrote more of the library tree directly. Both ultimately omitted the required test1.mjs entry, which is enough to explain the identical official failure.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out with repeated stalled child retries exhausted available closure budget before workflow aggregation.
Completed child implementation outputs remained in /tmp/wf or workflow results and were not adopted into the final /output artifact.
serial_contributors: Serial kept implementation in one direct trajectory and produced more /output/lib files.
Serial still timed out before producing /output/test1.mjs.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial used a generated Unicode-table architecture under lib/unicode and lib/python; parallel parent submitted a smaller set of core modules.
Both artifacts lacked the entrypoint required by the prompt and artifact validator.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are supported parallel adverse process episodes, not an explanation for a discordant result

The parallel workflow launched module builders and chained verifier agents through a pipeline, while stalled unicode-aux, diff-corpus, and verifier agents were repeatedly retried. The workflow state ended killed with active progress agents and 736107 workflow-child tokens, while the parent process had already reached the 2399 second timeout. This is broader than one oversized child: the collective breadth and retries displaced final assembly time.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel workflow did not return a complete aggregate result before the run closed, leaving several children still in progress and no completed final entry assembly.
candidates.near_match_reason: The workflow abort did stop active children, but that was the terminal symptom of the broader fan-out and retry budget exhaustion chain rather than a separately correctable premature stop.
